name: Wraith

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.effect: Target must pass WILL save or have their maximum HP reduced by the damage dealt. A humanoid killed by this rises as a Specter under the Wraith's command at the start of the Wraith's next turn.

actions.name: Shadow Strike
actions.effect: Can target any creature the Wraith can see within 18m by attacking through their shadow.

actions.name: Create Specter
actions.effect: Targets one humanoid corpse within 3m. The corpse rises as a Specter under the Wraith's control. The Wraith can control up to 3 Specters.

reactions.name: Incorporeal Escape
reactions.effect: When hit by a non-magical or non-radiant attack, the Wraith becomes fully incorporeal, reducing damage to 0. Cannot be used against radiant or force damage.

reactions.name: Darkness Shroud
reactions.effect: When an ally Specter within 9m is targeted, the Wraith extends its darkness to give the Specter +3 to defenses.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: Can move through creatures and objects. Takes 2d8 force damage if ending its turn in an object.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: In sunlight, the Wraith has -2d6 to attack rolls and saves, and its defenses are reduced by 3.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.desc: In dim light or darkness, the Wraith can Hide as a free action.

lore: Wraiths are among the most dreaded incorporeal undead, formed when a truly evil soul refuses to pass on. They command lesser spirits and build shadow armies, haunting ancient tombs and cursed battlefields.
